messages:
maria: Quick FYI — canary for continuous-batching v2.1.0 started at 12:05 UTC and we saw sustained CPU spikes on two hosts (~90-97%) after ~1500 qps. Not a full outage but latency SLOs degraded for a few minutes. Can we triage ownership + next steps?

henry: Thanks for the heads-up. Do we have the canary id and a small log snippet?

maria: Canary id cb-2026-03-18-1. Logs attached below (snip):
```
[2026-03-18T12:07:21Z] host=worker-7 kernel=continuous_batcher.cpp:423 process_batch took=1123ms tokens=310
[2026-03-18T12:07:22Z] host=worker-7 cpu=95% mem=68% queue_len=42
[2026-03-18T12:07:23Z] host=worker-3 kernel=kv_cache_manager.cpp:88 kv_lock_wait=230ms
[2026-03-18T12:07:25Z] host=worker-3 process_batch took=980ms tokens=280
```

henry: Hmm looks like both batching path and KV locks hit. Could be a regression from the prefetch change we merged last week. @tara is the prefetch PR owner, right?

tara: Yup that was my PR (prefetch-optimizations). I added async kv prefetch hooks in hotpath. I did local perf tests but not across higher concurrency. I can repro with a focused stress test.

devon: deploy-bot shows the rollout stopped automatically at 10% because latency crossed the canary threshold.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: Canary cb-2026-03-18-1 rollback triggered at 12:09 UTC — automatic rollback to v2.0.9 executed.

henry: Ok, action plan suggestion: 1) Tara to isolate whether prefetch change increases KV lock contention; 2) Sree to check kernel scheduling and CPU hotloops; 3) Anita to run a scaled synthetic with KV cache warm vs cold.

sree: I can look at CPU profiles from the affected hosts. Can we export perf traces for worker-3 and worker-7? Maria, do you have access to the trace artifacts?

maria: Uploaded traces to /mnt/artifacts/cb-2026-03-18-1/ (link: https://internal.artifacts/redwood/cb-2026-03-18-1). worker-7 trace shows heavy time in continuous_batcher::merge_batches loop. worker-3 shows long mutex waits in KVCache::get_or_prefetch.

tara: Thanks. I'll try reverting the async prefetch part in a patch branch and run the same canary script. If that fixes it we can iterate. I also want to add a low-latency path bypassing prefetch for small requests.

henry: I'll prep a perf test that reproduces both high-qps and moderate-qps to see thresholds. Can you share the stress script, Maria?

maria: stress script posted at https://git.redwood/stress/cb-canary.sh with run args in the artifacts folder. Use --qps 1500 --seq-len 512 --burst 100.

anita: I'll coordinate with infra to spin up a 6-host testbed (3 workers primed, 3 cold) tomorrow morning. ETA ~ 09:00 PT. Need a label for the test run so we can track logs.

tara: Label it cb-triage-20260319-0900. I'll run with and without async prefetch.

sree: From a quick glance, kernel side has a micro-optimizable branch where we call a heavy allocator inside the batching loop. If I can inline a small allocator fastpath it might reduce CPU by 8-12%. I'll prototype a patch today.

henry: Great. Who owns the final merge decision if both patches are needed? Suggest: Tara owns prefetch revert/patch, Sree owns kernel patch, Anita own infra validation. I'll approve merges after the test signals look good.

maria: Sounds good. Quick checklist: - Tara: repro + patch branch - Sree: kernel perf patch prototype - Anita: infra testbed + run - Henry: end-to-end perf harness + validation script - Maria: collect traces and tag artifacts

henry: Also, PR pings: @tara please add the performance regression test to your PR description. @sree please open a small PR with benchmark results attached. I'll review both today.

tara: Roger. Expecting to push a revert branch in ~2-3h and run quick local canaries.

anita: Spinning up testbed now, will ping when ready.

maria: FYI, user traffic during the incident was from a limited customer subset (routing A/B). No customer-facing errors, just degraded tail latency. Notifying support for heads-up.

devon: tagging the incident channel for awareness: #incidents. No Sev declared but tracking as P2 for the sprint.

henry: Thanks all — let's regroup in this thread when we have test results. If someone needs to offload tasks ping me directly. :eyes:

tara: thanks, will update in ~3h. :thumbsup:

sree: patch prototype coming up, will include perf numbers in PR.

anita: testbed ready (cb-triage-20260319-0900). Starting the first run now.

maria: closing the loop for now — logs, traces, and failure artifacts are in the artifact folder. Will attach latency graphs after the test completes.

henry: last note — add a short blameless note to the sprint board under 'Serving runtime perf' so we track follow-up work.

maria: added card: SERV-RUN-119 — continuous-batch canary regression triage.
